g.card: Tshintsha iiswitshi zikaloliwe uze ukhokele inqwelo nganye yomgodi kwindlela yokuphuma yombala wayo.
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: iiphazili zikaloliwe ezingama-90 kwimiqolomba yekristale emi-6. Tshintsha iiswitshi uze ukhokele inqwelo nganye kwindlela yokuphuma yombala wayo.
g.p1: Iinqwelo ziphuma etoneleni ziqengqeleke zodwa. Tshintsha iiswitshi ukuze nganye ifike kwindlela yokuphuma yombala wayo ngaphandle kokungqubana.
g.p2: Amanqanaba angama-90 kwimiqolomba emi-6: iilivali, iibhulorho ezijikelezayo, umkhenkce, amanzi anyukayo nelava. Fumana iinkwenkwezi ezi-3 ngeentshukumo ezimbalwa, kwaye isithwaya siyakunceda xa ubambekile.
l.card: Jikisa izipili, khokela imitha yokukhanya uze ukhanyise kwakhona iiholo ezili-150 zenqaba.
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: jikisa izipili uze ukhokele ukukhanya kwiikristale kumanqanaba ali-150 nakwiihlabathi ezi-6 ezipeyintiweyo.
l.p1: Inqaba icimile. Jikisa izipili neeholo ukuze ukhokele imitha kwiikristale: xa zonke zikhazimla, ucango lwegolide luyavuleka.
l.p2: Amanqanaba ali-150 kwiihlabathi ezi-6: imibala yokuxuba, iglasi enemibala, iiprizimu, imifanekiso eqingqiweyo neegiya. Amacebiso neenkwenkwezi ezi-3 kwinqanaba ngalinye kwabona bakrelekrele.
d.card: Baleka, bhabha uze uphefumle umlilo kwizikumkani zomlingo ezi-7 nakwiinkokeli zazo ezi-7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: umdlalo weqonga we-2D opeyintwe ngesandla. Wela izikumkani ezi-7, amanqanaba angama-63 neenkokeli ezi-7 ukuze ugxothe uKumkani weZithunzi.
d.p1: Dlala njengenamba encinci eluhlaza enesibindi. Baleka, tsiba, dada emoyeni uze uphefumle umlilo ukuze ugxothe uKumkani weZithunzi.
d.p2: Izikumkani ezi-7, amanqanaba angama-63 neenkokeli ezi-7, nganye inobuchule bayo. Qokelela iikristale uze ufumane ukuya kuthi ga kwiinkwenkwezi ezi-3 kwinqanaba ngalinye.
d.f2: Iinkokeli ezi-7 ekufuneka zoyiswe, nganye inobuchule bayo
t.card: Sika, jikisa uze ubeke amafu ukuze uvulele umthungi omncinci indlela.
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: iiphazili ezingama-240 kwimimandla eli-12 yesibhakabhaka. Sika, jikisa uze ubeke amafu ukuze uvule indlela.
t.p1: Iziqithi zidada esibhakabhakeni kwaye ucango lomlingo lulindile. Sika amafu, wajikise uze uwabeke ukuze wakhe indlela yomthungi omncinci.
t.p2: Amanqanaba angama-240 kwimimandla eli-12 epeyintiweyo, ngaphandle kwexesha elibekiweyo. Fumana iinkwenkwezi ezi-3, vula iibhokisi uze uqokelele amafu.
w.card: Beka iigiya, dlulisa amandla uze uvuse ubukumkani obulele.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: iiphazili zoomatshini ezili-150 kwiihlabathi zeentsomi ezi-6. Beka iigiya uze udlulise amandla ukuze uqalise kwakhona oomatshini.
w.p1: Isiqalekiso siqandise ubukumkani. Beka iigiya kwindawo efanelekileyo ukuze udlulise amandla enjini yomlingo kwaye wenze oomatshini basebenze kwakhona.
w.p2: Amanqanaba ali-150 kwiihlabathi ezi-6: iirune, iilivali, imitha yekristale nexesha lesanti. Fumana iinkwenkwezi ezi-3 uze ubukele iimephu zibuyisa imibala yazo.
u.card: Beka iibhloko zerune eziwayo uze udibanise iirune zombala omnye ukuze zinyamalale.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: beka iibhloko zerune eziwayo, dibanisa imibala uze uthungelanise iicombo kumanqanaba ali-180 nakwimimandla emi-6.
u.p1: Iibhloko zerune ziwela ebhodini. Zihambise uze uzijikise ukuze udibanise iirune zombala omnye: ziyanyamalala kwaye yonke into iwela ezantsi.
u.p2: Amanqanaba ali-180 kwimimandla emi-6, ukusuka kwiNqaba yeGqwirha ukuya kwiNqaba yeSibhakabhaka. Thungelanisa iicombo ukuze ufumane iinkwenkwezi ezi-3.
n.card: Khokela inamba, tya iirune uze ukhule ngaphandle kokuluma umsila wakho.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: umdlalo wenyoka onenamba. Tya iirune, phepha imiqobo uze woyise abalindi abathandathu kumanqanaba ali-120.
n.p1: Inamba ayize ime. Swayipha ukuze uyijikise, tya iirune ukuze ukhule kwaye uphephe iindonga nomzimba wakho.
n.p2: Amanqanaba ali-120 kwimimandla emi-6, nganye igadwe yinkokeli. Iirune zomlingo zicothisa ixesha, zikwenza isiporho okanye zikukhusele.
